channel.title: Department of War News Feed
channel.description: Stories from around the Department of War.

item.title: Navy High-Speed Wi-Fi Reaches Milestone for Global Unaccompanied Housing
item.description: The Navy's initiative to provide free, high-speed Wi-Fi to all Navy unaccompanied housing is 90% complete, with the service now available in 865 of 962 buildings since the rollout began in November 2025.
item.dc:creator: Commander, Navy Installations Command Headquarters Public Affairs

item.title: Kentucky Guardsmen Sharpen Capabilities Alongside NATO Partners
item.description: Airmen assigned to the Kentucky Air National Guard enhanced their global capabilities while training alongside NATO partners from the United Kingdom and Canada in Scotland this summer.
item.dc:creator: Dale Greer,123rd Airlift Wing

item.title: Marines to Support NATO Security Initiative in Baltic Sea
item.description: A specialized team of Marines deployed to Europe will be redirected to the Baltic Sea region to support the NATO-led enhanced vigilance activity Baltic Sentry.
item.dc:creator: Marine Corps Master Gunnery Sgt. Scott Schmidt, U.S. Marine Corps Forces, Europe and Africa

item.title: War Department Increases Two Hazard Pays for First Time in Nearly Quarter Century
item.description: The War Department announced an increase in hostile fire pay and imminent danger pay today for the first time since 2002.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: Hegseth Delivers 'State of the Force' Address, Outlines Series of New Initiatives
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth delivered a speech on the status of the military, during which he announced six new initiatives for the War Department.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: Government AI Models Advancing, Increasing Productivity
item.description: The War Department is working with industry partners to deploy the latest and greatest American artificial intelligence models and platforms, officials said today during GenAI.mil Excite Day at the Pentagon.
item.dc:creator: David Vergun

item.title: 'We Want to Hear From You,' Hegseth Tells Troops at Early Morning PT Session
item.description: About 600 midcareer enlisted service members and officers formed up on the Pentagon's parade field for the chance to do a morning workout with Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.
item.dc:creator: C. Todd Lopez

item.title: Army Nears Crucial Brain Health Testing Milestone
item.description: About 97% of soldiers have used the Neurocognitive Assessment Tool, helping medical professionals combat the effects of blast overpressure and low-level blast exposure, the Army's top leader overseeing safety and occupational health said.
item.dc:creator: Joe Lacdan, War Media Activity

item.title: War Department Prepares to Protect Election From Foreign Interference
item.description: Every seat in the U.S. House of Representatives and a third of U.S. Senate seats, some 470 contests in all, will be decided during the U.S. midterm elections Nov. 3, and the War Department will help ensure foreign actors don't meddle in the voting.
item.dc:creator: C. Todd Lopez

item.title: 75th Field Artillery Brigade, Singapore Complete Monthlong Exercise
item.description: Soldiers assigned to the 75th Field Artillery Brigade and the Singapore Armed Forces successfully concluded Exercise Daring Warrior 2026, finishing the bilateral training event with a decisive joint live-fire operation.
item.dc:creator: Army Capt. Lydia Laga, 75th Field Artillery Brigade
